# olivares_capability_config (Resource)

Configuration of an MCP server connection in the Olivares AI control plane (capabilities module): the "connector/source" of a tool server, declared as code. Secrets are referenced by locator only (never cleartext); the engine rejects an endpoint or ref carrying an inline credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configuration of an MCP server connection. Secrets are referenced by locator
# only (never cleartext); the engine rejects an endpoint or ref that embeds a
# credential.
resource "olivares_capability_config" "github_mcp" {
  server_ref = "github-mcp"
  transport  = "http"
  endpoint   = "https://mcp.internal/github"
  scope      = "team:platform"

  secret_refs = [
    {
      name     = "token"
      ref_kind = "vault"
      ref      = "secret/data/mcp/github#token"
      hint     = "ghp_…last4"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_ref` (String) Logical reference of the MCP server this config connects to.
- `transport` (String) Transport: one of stdio, http, sse, ws.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connection config is active. Defaults to true.
- `endpoint` (String) Connection endpoint reference (e.g. a URL or command). Never an inline credential — the engine rejects one.
- `note` (String) Optional free-text note.
- `scope` (String) Optional scope label constraining where the config applies.
- `secret_refs` (Attributes List) Secret references for the connection. Each is a LOCATOR (env var, Vault path, secret-manager key, file), never the secret value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secret_refs))
- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID for this resource, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned config ID.
- `revision` (Number) Engine-assigned revision, bumped on each update (the config keeps a revision history server-side).

<a id="nestedatt--secret_refs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secret_refs`

Required:

- `name` (String) Logical name of the secret (e.g. "api_key").
- `ref` (String) The locator (e.g. the env var name or Vault path). Never the credential value.
- `ref_kind` (String) Locator kind: one of env, vault, secret_manager, file, other.

Optional:

- `hint` (String) Optional short masked partial for operator recognition (e.g. "sk-…abcd"). Never a full credential.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import olivares_capability_config.github_mcp cfg_01HX...
```
